name: Unhelpful High School Teacher
look: A stock photo of a smiling young woman with long dark hair in a white blouse, standing in front of a colorful world map and a green chalkboard with EUROPE, ASIA and AMERICA partly visible, holding one open hand out toward the camera while gesturing back at the map.
use: An advice-animal style template. The top sets up a classroom situation and the bottom delivers the teacher's unhelpful, contradictory or hypocritical response, all said with the same cheerful smile.
slots: top caption: the classroom situation or the teacher's promise
examples: Says the test will be easy
Puts things we never covered on it
Ends class before anyone can answer
describe: smiling teacher pointing at a world map and reaching toward you
woman in a white shirt in front of a map gesturing at the camera
geography teacher stock photo with a chalkboard
friendly teacher holding out her hand in front of a classroom map
teacher smiling by a chalkboard that says europe asia america
origin: A stock photo of a teacher that became an advice-animal character for unhelpful classroom moments.
